propositions: Fourteen call sites hand-build identical single-turn structured request shapes with mode='structured', execution_mode='single_turn', and output_schema, violating the DRY principle and the documented RunRequest contract at runner.py:96-100 that these properties must stay consistent.

Bounding parameters (output_token_limit, structured_retry_limit, transport_attempt_limit, request_timeout_limit_s) are declared at only two sites (judge_batch and completion_recovery.py), leaving twelve sites silently unbounded and indistinguishable from deliberately unbounded ones, creating the conditions for bugs like 22da.

A new SingleTurnBounds dataclass with required non-defaulted fields and a RunRequest.for_structured(..., bounds=...) classmethod will make the bounding decision explicit and auditable at all adoption sites.

The oracle test _run_request_sites in test_subcall_class_selection.py matches only RunRequest(...) calls and will fail to see fourteen sites after adoption, requiring the matcher to also recognize RunRequest.for_structured(...).
